heading: How Patrick and Brittany Mahomes turned a $75 million soccer investment into a $325 million Kansas City sports empire
author: Global Sports Desk / TIMESOFINDIA.COM /  Sep 21, 2026, 17:42 IST
paragraphs: Patrick Mahomes has spent years making history on the football field
Alongside his wife, Brittany Mahomes, the Kansas City Chiefs quarterback is building a business portfolio that connects sports, community and long-term growth
Their investments span multiple leagues, with the Kansas City Current emerging as a major success story

Together, the couple is creating a lasting presence in Kansas City, even beyond Patrick's playing career.Patrick and Brittany Mahomes expand their Kansas City business empirePatrick Mahomes' business journey began with the Kansas City Royals in 2020, when he joined the MLB franchise's ownership group

He expanded his portfolio in 2021 by investing in Sporting Kansas City, adding professional soccer to his growing list of ventures.His wife, Brittany, has also played a central role in their business journey
A former collegiate soccer player at the University of Texas at Tyler, she co-founded the Kansas City Current in 2020
Patrick later joined the NWSL club's ownership group, turning the investment into a shared family venture.The club's growth has been remarkable
CPKC Stadium opened in March 2024 after an investment of nearly $120 million
Built specifically for women's professional soccer, the venue marked a major step for the NWSL.By 2026, the Kansas City Current's valuation had climbed from $75 million in 2024 to $325 million

The club also leads the league in annual revenue, generating $36 million.Brittany welcomed her husband's involvement, saying, "We are so thrilled to make this a family affair and have Patrick join as an owner
He has been a huge supporter behind the scenes

His passion for the Current is undeniable."The couple's sports investments also include Alpine's Formula One team, extending their reach beyond Kansas City and American football.Why Patrick Mahomes is investing in Kansas CityFor Mahomes, these ventures offer more than financial opportunities
They give him a way to remain involved in sports long after his NFL career ends.Forbes estimated his off-field earnings at $30 million in 2026, reflecting his growing business presence

His investment choices also show a clear connection to the city where he built his football career.When he joined Sporting KC's ownership group, Mahomes said, "Sporting is a community-oriented club, and I am excited to continue supporting the growth of soccer in Kansas City."He also shared his long-term vision in a 2021 interview: "I want to play for a long time but you can't play forever, but I always want to be involved in sports in some way."That approach now extends to the Kansas City Current's planned stadium expansion, which would increase capacity from 11,500 to 18,000 seats
